subject: Credit note for invoice INV-2526-02632
body:
Dear Global Retail & Co team,

We have reviewed invoice INV-2526-02632 dated 17 Feb 2026 and found that HSN 8528 was charged at 28 percent instead of the applicable 18 percent. The excess tax amount is Rs 27,532.

We will issue a credit note for Rs 27,532 and send a corrected invoice. Please adjust your records.
